# C.H. Robinson releases Edge Report: October freight market insights


#### October report explores tightening freight capacity, record diesel prices, and evolving global trade policy


-
-
-
-
- Copy to clipboard


Copy to clipboard


Link Copied


2026-10-06 | News


Read by more than 14,000 logistics leaders each month, the C.H. Robinson Edge Report brings together market data, expert analysis, and actionable guidance to help shippers stay ahead of volatility and plan with confidence.


[This month’s edition](https://www.chrobinson.com/en-us/resources/insights-and-advisories/north-america-freight-insights/oct-2026-freight-market-update/air/) looks at the trends in freight markets and supply chains as 2026 enters its final quarter. From tightening trucking capacity and record diesel prices to changing trade relationships and cross-border complexity, the report examines the developments shaping transportation strategies and costs.


**What insights are inside the October 2026 Edge Report?**


- **Freight market:** See updated insights across[truckload](https://www.chrobinson.com/en-us/resources/insights-and-advisories/north-america-freight-insights/oct-2026-freight-market-update/na-truckload/) , less-than-truckload (LTL), intermodal,[air freight](https://www.chrobinson.com/en-us/resources/insights-and-advisories/north-america-freight-insights/oct-2026-freight-market-update/air/) , ocean shipping, and ports and drayage. Learn how trucking conditions are increasing demand in the[LTL](https://www.chrobinson.com/en-us/resources/insights-and-advisories/north-america-freight-insights/oct-2026-freight-market-update/na-ltl/) and[intermodal](https://www.chrobinson.com/en-us/resources/insights-and-advisories/north-america-freight-insights/oct-2026-freight-market-update/intermodal/) markets, and see how post-Golden Week demand and port congestion are influencing[ocean freight](https://www.chrobinson.com/en-us/resources/insights-and-advisories/north-america-freight-insights/oct-2026-freight-market-update/ocean/) planning this October.
- **Canada, Mexico, and cross-border:** Learn how driver availability, border disruptions, and postponed U.S.-Mexico-Canada Agreement discussions are impacting[U.S.-Mexico freight](https://www.chrobinson.com/en-us/resources/insights-and-advisories/north-america-freight-insights/oct-2026-freight-market-update/cross-border/) , while new U.S. tariffs and import restrictions are straining Canada-U.S. trade.
- **Trade policy and government regulations:** Learn about the U.S.-China[trade negotiations](https://www.chrobinson.com/en-us/resources/insights-and-advisories/north-america-freight-insights/oct-2026-freight-market-update/customs/) and what expanding sanctions on Russia and Iran mean for goods that come from other countries.
- **Industry insights:** Get sector-specific perspectives for retail,[automotive](https://www.chrobinson.com/en-us/resources/insights-and-advisories/north-america-freight-insights/oct-2026-freight-market-update/industry-insights/automotive/) , energy, and healthcare supply chains. Learn how expanding food delivery and membership programs are reshaping[retail](https://www.chrobinson.com/en-us/resources/insights-and-advisories/north-america-freight-insights/oct-2026-freight-market-update/industry-insights/retail/) fulfillment, and how changing demand among gasoline, hybrid, and electric vehicles requires flexibility in automotive supply chains. Understand how geothermal growth is influencing[energy](https://www.chrobinson.com/en-us/resources/insights-and-advisories/north-america-freight-insights/oct-2026-freight-market-update/industry-insights/energy/) supply chains, while the shift toward home-based care is raising the stakes for[healthcare](https://www.chrobinson.com/en-us/resources/insights-and-advisories/north-america-freight-insights/oct-2026-freight-market-update/industry-insights/healthcare/) final-mile delivery.
- **Diesel fuel:** See why[diesel](https://www.chrobinson.com/en-us/resources/insights-and-advisories/north-america-freight-insights/oct-2026-freight-market-update/diesel/) prices are rising faster than crude oil and affecting transportation costs and 2027 budget planning.


**The October Edge Report is now live**


As market conditions and trade policies evolve, the October Edge Report provides the clarity logistics leaders need to adapt and stay resilient. Read the full report and download the shareable highlights to inform your planning for the months ahead.
